decisions.reason: The product appears to have survived the initial post-launch review, fits the firm's dental-lab materials business, and a large firm with some slack would likely retain it unless results fall clearly below aspiration.
As a core thermoforming material closely tied to existing laboratory workflows and capabilities, it is likely meeting at least satisfactory aspirations and therefore is more likely to be kept.

This accessory product is less central and seems to have had a lighter market presence, so it faces a higher risk of failing aspiration levels, but the firm would still likely continue it while results remain uncertain.
The custom hearing-protection line strongly matches the firm's custom manufacturing skills and hearing-care channels, making it the most likely to stay unless performance deteriorates markedly.
